# HEM v0.8.5b4

Large installations can keep Home Assistant's HTTP and WebSocket requests waiting while hundreds of equipment entities refresh. HEM now processes pending equipment state writes in small batches and yields between batches. Overlapping updates for the same entity publish its latest values once.

HEM also reuses merged Home Assistant entry settings until a configuration edit, reads the native supply switch directly, and reuses the controller profile while publishing one entity. Changes to native capabilities, operating modes and configuration are picked up on subsequent state writes.
